filing_fee_notes: Base formation fee. Credit-card payments add 0.25 plus 2.25 percent of total fees.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a consenting Texas resident or qualifying business agent with a physical Texas registered office available during business hours. The LLC cannot serve as its own agent.
annual_report_due: May 15; the next business day applies when the deadline falls on a weekend or legal holiday.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Texas franchise-tax requirements depend on revenue, entity status and exemptions. The Public Information Report is a separate filing requirement.
plain_english_summary: Formation costs 300. LLCs file their annual Public Information Report with the Comptroller.
common_mistake: Owing no franchise tax does not automatically remove the Public Information Report requirement.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Annual-report fields refer to the Comptroller's Public Information Report, not a Secretary of State report; its separate filing fee was not confirmed. Formation URL is the official online-filing instructions gateway. Tax-registration URL covers sales and use tax. Name-search URL, processing time, expedited service, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
